prompt_text: Which residential pest control companies are the most reputable in the Northeast US (New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania)?
response_text:
When selecting a reputable residential pest control company in the Northeast U.S., particularly in New York, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania, consider the following options:

**[All Platinum Termite & Pest Control](https://www.google.com/maps/search/All+Platinum+Termite+%26+Pest+Control%2C+Staten+Island%2C+NY?utm_source=openai)**
_Staten Island, NY_
A family-owned business serving the Tri-State area, offering same-day service with over 1,200 five-star reviews. They provide residential and commercial pest control using environmentally friendly products.

**[Viking Pest Control](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Viking+Pest+Control%2C+Basking+Ridge%2C+NJ?utm_source=openai)**
_Basking Ridge, NJ_
With over 45 years of experience, Viking offers eco-friendly, science-backed treatments across NJ, PA, DE, and MD. Recognized by Forbes Home and Better Homes & Gardens, they provide both residential and commercial services.

**[Nature Plus Pest Control](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Nature+Plus+Pest+Control%2C+Brooklyn%2C+NY?utm_source=openai)**
_Brooklyn, NY_
Licensed and insured professionals offering pest and termite control services across NY, NJ, PA, and DE. They emphasize transparent pricing and a quality guarantee, with 24/7 availability and same-day service for emergencies.

**[Environmina Pest Control](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Environmina+Pest+Control%2C+New+Brunswick%2C+NJ?utm_source=openai)**
_New Brunswick, NJ_
A New Jersey-based company led by a licensed chemist and toxicologist with over 10 years of experience. They offer 24/7 service across multiple NJ counties, specializing in various pest control services.

**[Rest Easy Pest Control](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Rest+Easy+Pest+Control%2C+New+York%2C+NY?utm_source=openai)**
_New York, NY_
Serving NY, NJ, and PA since 2012, they have over 2,500 Google reviews with a 4.9-star rating. They offer free quotes, same-day service, and are licensed and insured.

**[A3 Superior Pest Control](https://www.google.com/maps/search/A3+Superior+Pest+Control%2C+Monticello%2C+NY?utm_source=openai)**
_Monticello, NY_
Operating since 2004, they provide comprehensive pest control services across NY, NJ, and PA, employing Integrated Pest Management strategies for both residential and commercial clients.

**[Cooper Pest Solutions](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Cooper+Pest+Solutions%2C+Hamilton%2C+NJ?utm_source=openai)**
_Hamilton, NJ_
Serving NJ and PA since 1955, they offer one-time services and year-round prevention plans. Known for using less pesticides and providing guaranteed results with free estimates.

**[Horizon Pest Control](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Horizon+Pest+Control%2C+Midland+Park%2C+NJ?utm_source=openai)**
_Midland Park, NJ_
A family-owned business since 1970, offering residential pest control in NJ and NY. They provide a Home Guard Program covering over 40 common household pests with seasonally scheduled services.

When choosing a pest control service, consider factors such as the company's experience, range of services, customer reviews, and commitment to environmentally friendly practices. It's advisable to contact multiple providers to compare quotes and services to find the best fit for your specific needs.
